links.claim: ZNF696 has its own QBiC-SELEX model in group G570 and binds the alt G allele more strongly than ref T in vitro (effect 0.733, alt binds more); no ZNF696 ChIP or allele-specific occupancy assay is available.
The candidate element is the dELS EH38E2269392 42 bp away; the variant does not overlap a cCRE, and HCT116-specific enhancer activity is not shown.

PYDC2 is the nearest protein-coding gene and is listed near the dELS, but the variant is intronic in PYDC2-AS1 and GTEx reports no colon-transverse eQTL for this variant; the gene link is proximity-only.
ZNF696 is expressed in the HCT116 DepMap context at 8.26 TPM, supporting expression in the relevant cell type but not occupancy or function.

No GWAS Catalog or Open Targets association supports rs13078086, and Open Targets reports no PYDC2 colorectal-cancer association; the phenotype link is speculative, and the downstream direction of ZNF696 activity is unknown.
